scope: Mode-resolved massless continuum source-response predictor with a uniform modal-truncation theorem; no lattice evolution, detector-history comparison, or full dictionary validation.
dictionary: D1 native cell-source integrals on the N22 interior cells; the same affine apparatus boundary constants. Centering removes constants from the vacuum response; no new source smoothing or boundary convention.
model: M_M(t)=sum_{n=1}^M b_n b_n^T exp(-i omega_n t)/(2 pi omega_n), omega_n=sqrt((n pi/L)^2+1/pi). Canonical R_M=C_M^(-1/2) M_M C_M^(-1/2), C_M=M_M(0). Scalar witnesses use their own retained variance.
primary_claim: For the exact mathematical primary three-sine predictor at the fixed M=1024, an a priori rational envelope bounds canonical normalized error uniformly over every real time by less than0.001. Floating implementation validation and the mathematical truncation theorem are distinct claims.
a_priori_certificate: Use3<pi<22/7, q23, source L2 projection, Poincare interior error and edge sin bound. cmin_lower=(9/40)*(9/16)/(2*(22/7)*(87/35)); cmax_upper=1/16; tail_E_upper=7/(9*M^2). Uniform canonical bound E*(1/cmin_lower+cmax_upper/cmin_lower^2). Verify the pi bracket by exact rational alternating Machin series and every certificate inequality by Fraction arithmetic.
comparison_rules: Every fixed level is compared to the32768 reference at every fixed time. Raw, canonical and scalar errors must obey their two-sided reference-tail allowances plus1e-10 floating slack. Reference16384vs32768 canonical/auto response difference must be<=1e-7. Frozen R1 independent implementation is compared at16384, new times, only as an implementation check. No level is chosen after results.
quality_vs_operational: Report numerical quality, bound compliance, exact-arithmetic primary truncation certificate, and measured held-out differences separately. Beta is a scalar witness outside primary whitening and the exact rational primary certificate.
stop_rule: One bounded evaluation; no adaptive modes, new times, refitting frequencies or weights, lattice runs, cutoff escalation, or retrospective threshold change. A numerical implementation failure does not falsify the theorem and must remain reported.
limitations: No repair of R1 lattice/continuum response mismatch
No selective or nonlinear detector-history claim
